def print_deprecation_message(old_command: str, deprecation_date: datetime,
    new_command: Optional[str]=None) ->None:
    deprecation_str = f"DEPRECATED: this command (`{old_command}`) has been DEPRECATED"
    if deprecation_date:
        if isinstance(deprecation_date, datetime):
            date_str = deprecation_date.strftime("%d %B %Y")
        else:
            date_str = deprecation_date.strftime("%d %B %Y")
        deprecation_str += f" and will be unsupported after {date_str}"
    if new_command:
        deprecation_str += f". Please use `{new_command}` instead"
    deprecation_str += "."
    click.secho(deprecation_str, fg="yellow", err=False)
